verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a dedicated Webhook API. Developers can create, list, and delete webhook subscriptions at organization, user, or group scope. Payloads are delivered in real time for scheduling, cancellation, rescheduling, routing-form, Contacts, and Notetaker events. Deliveries are verified with signing keys, retried with exponential back-off for 24 hours, and can be tested against a sample-data endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook delivery works as documented.
